title: sample media in the IYAKKI samples folder (manual until automated)

clauses.text: On a fresh install a read-only IYAKKI samples folder holds the melody, the beat and a short video.

steps.do: Open MEDIA on a fresh library.
steps.expect: A folder named IYAKKI samples is listed with the sample MP3 files and the short video. Try to delete or rename a file in it: it is refused because the folder is read-only.

clauses.text: The sample MP3 files play in IYAKKI with sound from the speakers.

steps.do: Play the sample melody, then the kuthu-style beat.
steps.expect: Both play all the way through with clear sound at normal pitch.

clauses.text: Searching for kuthu finds the beats.

steps.expect: The sample beat is among the results.

clauses.text: The sample video plays in the MEDIA page with moving pictures, a time, a seek bar, and Space pauses.

steps.do: Open the sample video in MEDIA. Press Space to pause, then Space again.
steps.expect: The picture moves, a time and seek bar show, and Space pauses and resumes.

steps.do: Play the sample video with the volume up and listen.
steps.expect: Sound is heard with the picture. If it is silent, check the volume is not muted, and write what you found in the note.
